meaning/minute.why: Same answer from both. Y's 'added a zero' is loose wording but true to the figure.

noticeable.why: The engine's text says 'span of six hours' a moment earlier and then 'nine to five sixty hours', which jars; a careful reader would likely notice. X says no.

stakes.why: Both say yes: six vs sixty hours is the core of the anecdote.

rule.why: All 4 other engines wrote six; the evidence holds.

blind.why: X picks 'sixty' in both orders, ignoring the 'span of six hours' just before. Y flips but at least picks 'six' once.

rank.why: At the spot all four other engines wrote six. X ranks them equal and Parakeet last. Y spreads them out over words outside the spot ('old brain', 9-5).

misses.why: Both find gig->week and gig->gift, and both miss the case itself (six->sixty). Y adds more trivia (month/months, he/you, the edge words 'a boy') at inflated severity 3.

overall.why: Y is better on noticeable and the blind test (X is wrong in both orders there); X is better on rank and misses.
